name: LENGTH
description: Characters in a string, items in a list, or keys in a dictionary.

name: UPPER
description: Upper-case copy of a string.

name: LOWER
description: Lower-case copy of a string.

name: TRIM
description: Removes whitespace from both ends of a string.

name: SPLIT
description: Splits text at every separator. An empty separator splits into characters.

name: JOIN
description: Joins the items of a list into one string.

name: REPLACE
description: Replaces every occurrence of `old` with `new`. An empty `old` leaves the text unchanged.

name: SUBSTRING
description: Up to `length` characters starting at character index `start` (counted in characters, not bytes). Negative arguments are an error.

name: INDEX_OF
description: Character index of the first match in a string, or index of the first equal item in a list. -1 when not found.

name: REVERSE
description: Reversed copy of a string or a list.

name: REPEAT_STRING
description: The text repeated `times` times (result limited to 100,000,000 bytes).

name: CONTAINS
description: TRUE when `part` occurs inside `text`.

name: STARTS_WITH
description: TRUE when the text begins with `prefix`.

name: ENDS_WITH
description: TRUE when the text ends with `suffix`.

name: TO_STRING
description: Text form of any value (the same text SAY would print for a string).

name: TO_INT
description: Converts a string (surrounding spaces allowed), float (truncated), boolean or int to an integer. Invalid input is an error.

name: TO_FLOAT
description: Converts a string, int or boolean to a float. Invalid input is an error.

name: TYPE_OF
description: "int", "float", "bool", "string", "list", "dict", "error", "null", "handle", or the class name for an object.

name: IS_ERROR
description: TRUE when the value is an error value.

name: ERROR_MESSAGE
description: The message of an error value.

name: ABS
description: Absolute value. Integers stay exact.

name: SQRT
description: Square root. A negative number is an error.

name: POW
description: `base` raised to `exponent`.

name: FLOOR
description: Largest integer not above the number.

name: CEIL
description: Smallest integer not below the number.

name: ROUND
description: Nearest integer; halves round away from zero.

name: SIN
description: Sine of an angle in radians.

name: COS
description: Cosine of an angle in radians.

name: TAN
description: Tangent of an angle in radians.

name: EXP
description: e raised to the number.

name: LOG
description: Natural logarithm. A number that is not positive is an error.

name: PI
description: The constant pi.

name: SIGN
description: -1, 0 or 1 according to the sign.

name: MOD
description: Remainder (the same as `a % b`). A zero divisor is an error.

name: MIN
description: The smaller of two numbers or two strings (the original value is returned).

name: MAX
description: The larger of two numbers or two strings.

name: CLAMP
description: Limits `value` to the range low..high. `low` must not exceed `high`.

name: RANDOM
description: A random float in [0, 1).

name: RANDOM_INT
description: A random integer from low to high, both included.

name: SEED
description: Makes the random sequence reproducible: the same seed always gives the same numbers.

name: APPEND
description: Adds an item to the end of a list (in place). Returns TRUE.

name: REMOVE
description: Removes and returns the item at `index`. An index out of range is an error.

name: RANGE
description: The integers from `start` to `end`, both included (at most 10,000,000 items).
example: REPEAT FOR EACH i IN RANGE(1, 5)

name: SORT
description: A new list in ascending order. Works for a list of numbers or a list of strings.

name: SLICE
description: The part from `start` up to (not including) `end`. Indexes past the end are clamped; negative indexes are an error.

name: CONCAT
description: A new list with the items of both lists.

name: UNIQUE
description: The distinct items in first-seen order (quadratic time, meant for modest lists).

name: COPY
description: A shallow copy of a list or dictionary.

name: SUM
description: Sum of a list of numbers. An empty list gives 0.

name: LIST_MIN
description: Smallest item of a non-empty list of numbers or strings.

name: LIST_MAX
description: Largest item of a non-empty list of numbers or strings.

name: KEYS
description: The keys of a dictionary, sorted.

name: VALUES
description: The values of a dictionary in key order.

name: HAS_KEY
description: TRUE when the dictionary has the key.

name: DELETE_KEY
description: Removes a key. Returns TRUE when the key existed.

name: READ_FILE
description: The whole contents of a text file. Failure is an error.

name: WRITE_FILE
description: Writes (and overwrites) a text file.

name: APPEND_FILE
description: Appends text to a file, creating it if needed.

name: READ_LINES
description: Reads a file line by line; use it with REPEAT FOR EACH.
example: REPEAT FOR EACH line IN READ_LINES("log.txt")

name: FILE_EXISTS
description: TRUE when the path exists.

name: ENV
description: The value of an environment variable. A missing variable is an error.

name: ARGS
description: The command-line arguments after the program name.

name: NOW_MS
description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

name: SLEEP
description: Pauses the program (0 to 3,600,000 ms). Output is flushed first.

name: EXIT
description: Flushes output and ends the program with an exit status.

name: JSON_ENCODE
description: JSON text for a number, boolean, string, list, dictionary or null. Dictionary keys are sorted and an object loses its hidden class tag. Errors cannot be encoded.

name: JSON_DECODE
description: Parses JSON into lists, dictionaries, numbers, booleans, strings and null. Whole numbers become integers. Invalid JSON is an error that names the position.
